author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Between 2021 and 2023, Antarctica experienced a notable gain in ice mass, primarily driven by exceptional snowfall in East Antarctica. This unusual occurrence, influenced by warmer tropical ocean temperatures, caused atmospheric disturbances that transported moisture southward. Although this gain temporarily countered ongoing ice loss in other regions, it does not signify a change in Antarctica's long-term trend of declining ice mass.
title: Antarctica gained record 695 billion tons of ice after decades of loss

description: Bianca Belair’s road to being WWE’s EST is more than just championship wins. Her story is one of a powerful family legacy, athletic setbacks, personal resilience and the support of her husband, Montez Ford. Belair continues to build a family story that is grounded in strength, inspiration, perseverance and love; from overcoming challenges before wrestling to embracing motherhood in 2026.

description: The Pentagon is close to selecting a company for the US Navy's next-generation stealth fighter. Boeing and Northrop Grumman are competing for this significant contract, which could be worth billions. This advanced aircraft is intended to replace the aging F/A-18 Super Hornet fleet. The new fighter is expected to enter service in the 2030s and will feature advanced stealth.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Controlling invasive spotted knapweed biologically has initiated an unexpected ecological chain reaction. Gall flies, introduced as a control measure, have turned into a vital winter food source for deer mice, causing a surge in their populations and an uptick in hantavirus spread. Areas dense with knapweed report more infected mice than those with native grasslands.

description: Hog Island Audubon Camp marks an impressive ninety years of promoting environmental education and research. Located in Maine, this island was rescued from deforestation by environmentalists Millicent Todd Bingham and Mabel Loomis Todd. The camp is also the birthplace of Project Puffin, which successfully revitalized seabird numbers. Today, it remains a vital training ground for future scientists, educators, and artists, with its influence extending to bird conservation throughout North America.
title: Maine island bought to stop clear-cutting is now a 330-acre sanctuary

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Scientists tested cloud seeding over China’s Muz Taw Glacier in 2018 to create artificial snowfall and slow ice loss. The experiment used silver iodide generators to encourage snow formation. Researchers found that fresh snow made the glacier surface brighter and reduced the amount of ice lost over a short period. However, they said the results are preliminary and need further testing.
title: Scientists seeded clouds over Chinese glacier; ice loss later fell up to 17%

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: The race for the 2026 Ballon d'Or is officially underway, featuring a dazzling array of talent. Defending champion Ousmane Dembélé is set to clash with fierce rivals like Kylian Mbappé, Harry Kane, and the legendary Lionel Messi. description: A magnitude 5.3 earthquake struck Tibet recently, following another tremor last week.  Devastating flash floods hit the Tibet-Nepal border on August 26, causing widespread destruction.  The disaster has raised concerns over the fragile Qinghai-Tibet Plateau environment.  Rising temperatures and glacier melt are cited as contributing factors to the floods.  Nepal's death toll from the floods has risen to 1,357 people.

Despite this, Ponting remains optimistic that Test cricket will thrive, as major cricketing nations continue to value the longest format.

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Archaeologists have unearthed the skeletal remains of a man tucked inside a massive Roman storage jar, offering a chilling glimpse into the past. It appears he sought refuge from a violent raid, as evidenced by the surrounding destruction and signs of fire. Two iron knives discovered alongside him imply a desperate act of self-defense. This city's fate remained enigmatic for an astonishing sixteen centuries before it was eventually rebuilt.
